fields.Name: T346 - Diff Viewer Mode Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the DiffMode branch that renders different selector UI (label-to-label two-selector + swap vs label-to-current single selector) via OnDiffModeChange — UI-only and data-agnostic.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo → 'Version History'), click the 'Diff Viewer' item in the left navigation. Confirm two mode buttons appear: 'Label vs Current' and 'Label vs Label'. Switch to 'Label vs Label' and confirm a second 'To label' selector plus a swap button appear; switch back to 'Label vs Current' and confirm a 'Current State' indicator appears. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Diff Viewer shows two mode buttons (Label vs Current / Label vs Label)
Selecting Label vs Label reveals a second 'To label' selector and a swap control
Selecting Label vs Current shows a 'Current State' indicator
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
